meta.title: Annual Survey of Hours and Earnings: median pay by residence and workplace
meta.next_update: Oct/Nov each year (provisional), revised the following year
meta.quality: Accredited official statistics from a 1% sample of HMRC PAYE records (employer-reported). `ci` is an approximate 95% half-width derived from the Nomis coefficient of variation (attrs.cv_pct): 1.96 x CV x value.
meta.limitations: Latest year is provisional and revised a year later. Employees only (no self-employed). Estimates with CV > 20% are suppressed by ONS (null, suppressed). Residence vs workplace gap indicates commuting to higher-paid jobs elsewhere (e.g. London). No BEDS total (medians cannot be summed).
